title: Hviezdne noci 2025
authors: Kristína Majger, Richard Michalík, Karolína Majková
description:
Hviezdne noci are a platform, festival, promotional agency, collective, and community.

Since the festival of the same name was established in Bytča in 2015, we have organized hundreds of concerts and events. What began in a small town in northern Slovakia later spread across the country.
role: Art Director, Driver, Helper, Concept Co–Creator
